nodes.name: Start here: prepare a client delivery

parameters.content:
## Prepare a reviewable client delivery
For automation consultants handing completed work to a client. This workflow creates a saved Prooftask delivery job. It stops before sending. Client acceptance happens separately.

### Before you run
1. Use an existing Prooftask project with agreed criteria.
2. Authorize a scoped Agent connection at https://prooftask.com/developers?utm_source=partner&utm_campaign=n8n_creator
3. On the HTTP node, select Header Auth with Authorization: Bearer <your scoped token>. Never paste secrets into this workflow.
4. Replace every example in Input with actual project, criterion, materials and workflow references. Use one UUID v4 requestId per intended delivery and preserve it for retries.

nodes.name: Keep the saved job for deliberate submission

parameters.content:
## Keep the returned job ID
Persist the returned job ID in your existing task system. Review the exact materials before using the separate send-job workflow.

This template does not send a delivery, accept work, sign or pay. Preparation still writes a saved job, so run only for an authorized real project.

Prooftask account, project and Agent grant required; service pricing applies separately. No credentials or pinned customer data are included.

Setup and companion workflows: https://github.com/cognitive-emergence/prooftask-integrations/tree/main/n8n
